# technitium_cluster (Resource)

Initializes Technitium native clustering (v14+) with the provider's server as the Primary node. The cluster domain cannot be changed after initialization. Initialization creates the cluster Primary zone and the cluster Catalog zone (cluster-catalog.<cluster_domain>) automatically, and enables HTTPS on the web service with a self-signed certificate when HTTPS is not already configured — configure a valid TLS certificate via technitium_server_settings before creating this resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_domain` (String) Fully qualified domain name identifying the cluster. Cannot be changed after initialization.
- `primary_node_ip_addresses` (List of String) Static IP addresses of this server, reachable by all Secondary nodes.

### Optional

- `force_delete` (Boolean) Delete the cluster on destroy even when Secondary nodes are still joined.

### Read-Only

- `dns_server_domain` (String) The Primary node's DNS server domain name.
- `id` (String) The cluster domain.
